# OpenELIS Design Gallery

> Design mockups and functional requirement specs for OpenELIS Global, an open-source laboratory information management system. 202 designs across 16 categories.

## Catalog
- [JSON Catalog](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/catalog.json): Machine-readable index of all designs
- [HTML Catalog](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/catalog.html): Browsable plain-HTML catalog
- [Full Spec Content](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/llms-full.txt): All spec documents concatenated

## Admin & Config
- [Test Catalog Editor — Completion & Correction](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/admin-config/test-catalog-editor-completion.md): Completes the unified Test Catalog editor: create a test in place, edit shared settings across same-analyte/different-specimen tests together, result-type-first Sample & Results with live preview, LOINC integrity warnings (missing + duplicate-active), Ranges bug fixes, and language fallback for names/labels.
- [Report Management](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/admin-config/report-management.md): Admin registry to choose, version, and override the report templates OpenELIS uses to render reports — see the active template per report, whether it is the shipped default or a custom override, pick a bundled variant, upload a custom template, preview, and revert to the shipped default (OGC-1111, Epic).
- [Data Dictionary](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/admin-config/data-dictionary.md): Data dictionary management interface
- [Lab Units](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/admin-config/lab-units.md): Laboratory units configuration
- [Methods](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/admin-config/methods.md): Test methods management
- [Organizations Management](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/admin-config/organizations-management.md): Organizations and referring facilities management
- [Barcode Configuration](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/admin-config/barcode-config.md): Barcode label v1 — freezer labels and order entry label configuration, field mapping, and system label type setup (OGC-284 gap analysis + v1.1 cohesive rewrite)
- [Barcode Labels v2](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/admin-config/barcode-labels.md): Admin-configurable label preset system — lab admins define custom label types with dimensions, barcode style, and content fields; Test Catalog declares label requirements; Order Entry aggregates into a deterministic label workload
- [Panel](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/admin-config/panel.md): Test panel configuration
- [Range Editor](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/admin-config/range-editor.md): Normal range editor for test results
- [Result Options](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/admin-config/result-options.md): Result options (dictionary values) management
- [Test Catalog](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/admin-config/test-catalog.md): Admin surface where lab managers define all tests offered — 14-section routed editor covering identity, result types, ranges, sample storage, panels, analyzers, alerts, AMR mapping, regulatory compliance thresholds, LOINC/SNOMED/CIEL/OCL terminology, and order entry configuration. Replaces five separate admin pages (Test, Section, Panel, Method, Reagent). v2.4: Result Components + multi-reading — each test has N labeled subresult fields (e.g., noise = heading° + dB); per-component result type, unit (FK to master table via ComboBox + inline Add), ranges, and FHIR one-Observation-per-component mapping.
- [Test Catalog FRS v2.4](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/admin-config/test-catalog/test-catalog-requirements-v2.4.md): Test Catalog Management source-of-truth FRS (~3275 lines) — 14-section editor covering identity, result types, ranges, sample storage, display order, panels, terminology mappings, analyzers, alerts, AMR mapping, compliance, reagents, labels, reflex/calc, and localization hardening. Covers v1 (16 epics) and v2 (8 epics) delivery waves.
- [Test Catalog FRS v2.5](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/admin-config/test-catalog/test-catalog-requirements-v2.5.md): Test Catalog Management v2.5 staging companion — v1/v2 wave tags applied per section, 11 health-check fixes (D-01 through D-11) applied inline. Use alongside FRS v2.4 for implementation.
- [Test Catalog v2.5 — v1 Preview](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/admin-config/test-catalog/test-catalog-requirements-v2.5.md): Standalone HTML preview of the v1 Test Catalog editor — 9 sections functional (Editor Scaffold, Test List, Basic Info, Sample & Results, Methods, Ranges, Sample Storage, Display Order, Panels, Terminology, Analyzers). Opens in any browser without a build step.
- [Test Catalog v2.5 — Design Critique](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/admin-config/test-catalog/test-catalog-v2.5-design-critique.md): Structured critique across IA, Carbon design system, accessibility, and clinical workflow — 18 punch-list items, all triaged and applied to the v2.5 FRS.
- [Test Catalog v2.5 — Staging Review](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/admin-config/test-catalog/test-catalog-v2.5-staging-review.md): Earlier v1/v2 staging proposal documenting the split between delivery waves; historical context for the current epic structure.
- [Test Catalog v2.5 — Epic Restructure Plan](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/admin-config/test-catalog/test-catalog-v2.5-epic-restructure.md): 1-mockup-per-epic restructure plan converting 2 umbrella epics (OGC-746, OGC-759) into 24 focused epics, each sized for a 2-week sprint.
- [Test Catalog v2.5 — v1 Jira Story Breakdown](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/admin-config/test-catalog/test-catalog-v2.5-v1-jira.md): Historical v1 story breakdown as originally filed under OGC-746 umbrella — 16 stories. Superseded by the per-epic restructure; preserved as reference.
- [Test Catalog v2.5 — v2 Jira Story Breakdown](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/admin-config/test-catalog/test-catalog-v2.5-v2-jira.md): Historical v2 story breakdown as originally filed under OGC-759 umbrella — 8 stories. Superseded by the per-epic restructure; preserved as reference.
- [Test Catalog — Microbiology Workflow Attribute](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/admin-config/test-catalog-microbiology-workflow-attribute.md): Test Catalog Basic Info: a nullable culture_workflow_type enum (None / Bacteriology / Mycobacteriology\u2013TB; Mycology reserved), orthogonal to Domain and the AMR flag; drives micro case routing (M-03/M-04). Foldable into Test Catalog v2.5 \u00a72.1 Basic Info.
- [Admin Redesign — MVP Scope](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/admin-config/admin-mvp-scope.md): Umbrella scope/FRS for the OpenELIS admin redesign MVP — Admin Shell + consolidated pages (42→27 pages), and the per-feature configuration surfaces below.
- [Application Properties](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/admin-config/admin-mvp-scope.md): Admin redesign: consolidated Application/Common Properties editor (61 properties across 7 domains).
- [Feature Flags](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/admin-config/admin-mvp-scope.md): Admin redesign: Feature Flags tab in Application Settings (hybrid auto-aggregate + curated dictionary).
- [Menu Configuration](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/admin-config/admin-mvp-scope.md): Admin redesign: Menu Configuration across 5 scopes with per-node Side Nav Active + Show Child Elements toggles.
- [Site Information](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/admin-config/admin-mvp-scope.md): Admin redesign: Site Information editor (29 properties; banner heading, patient-search, training installation).
- [Validation Configuration](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/admin-config/admin-mvp-scope.md): Admin redesign: Validation Configuration with a live try-a-value charset preview (firstName/lastName/patientId/userName).
- [Test Notification](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/admin-config/admin-mvp-scope.md): Admin redesign: Test Notification config — 4 channels, 3-tier template fallback, substitution variables.
- [Order & Patient Entry](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/admin-config/admin-mvp-scope.md): Admin redesign: merged Order Entry + Patient Entry configuration (22 properties; conditional fields grey out when parent toggle off).
- [WorkPlan Configuration](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/admin-config/admin-mvp-scope.md): Admin redesign: WorkPlan Configuration with live workplan preview showing columns conditionally (nextVisit/results/subject).
- [RBAC Management](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/rbac/rbac-revamp-prd.md): Role-based access control revamp — role management, permission matrix, user assignment
- [Password Policy Enhancements](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/admin-config/password-enhancements.md): OWASP-aligned password policy with force-reset on next login, length-based rules, and Unicode support
- [Catalog Subscription](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/admin-config/catalog-subscription.md): Subscribe to external FHIR-based metadata catalogs (EUCAST, WHO, national reference labs) and selectively sync test definitions and clinical decision rules — field-level diff review preserves local customizations
- [Sample Type Management](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/admin-config/sample-type-management.md): Sample Type Management (OGC-296) — v2.1. Managed as a context in the Test Catalog Management shell (peer of Tests/Panels) with SideNav sections rather than a standalone 5-tab page. Sections: Basic Info (incl. required single Clinical/Environmental/Vector domain), Associated Tests (read-only — a test\
- [Sample Type Multi-Domain Addendum](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/admin-config/sample-type-multi-domain-addendum.md): OGC-296 Addendum — replaces single-value sampleDomain enum with Set<SampleDomain> so a sample type can belong to multiple domain contexts simultaneously (Clinical, Environmental, Vector). Covers entity change, migration, API serialization as string array, and S-04 UI impact (CheckboxGroup replacing single Select).
- [Concept Mapping & Multi-Coding](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/admin-config/concept-mapping-multi-coding.md): T-01 — polymorphic ConceptMapping table enabling any supported entity (Test, SampleType, VectorSpecies, VectorGroup, ComplianceThreshold) to carry multiple codings across multiple code systems. Builds out the stubbed Terminology tab in Test Editor with a shared <MultiCodingPanel> component. Primary-first FHIR CodeableConcept emission. Integrates with Catalog & Terminology Subscription (OGC-447 v1.1).
- [User Management](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/admin-config/user-management.md): Phase 5 admin redesign — People & Access bucket. User list with role badges, inline create/edit with Carbon SideNav submenu, role assignment multi-select, account status toggle, last-login audit, and permission-gated actions. Covers ROLE_MANAGE and USER_MANAGE permission keys.
- [Test Accreditation & Report Logo Threshold](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/admin-config/test-accreditation.md): Manage accrediting bodies and per-test accreditations from two dedicated Carbon SideNav submenu pages under Test Catalog Management. Conditionally render per-body accreditation logos on patient result reports based on configurable logo visibility thresholds (Any accredited test vs. percentage). FRS v4.
- [Reporting Ranges by Method](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/admin-config/reporting-ranges-by-method.md): Per-method reporting ranges for Test Catalog (FRS v2, full spec). Methods as first-class concepts: master Methods admin page (MANUAL/USER/PLUGIN sources, P-01 table pattern), per-method reporting range grid in test row-expand (Sub-2 + Sub-3), method-aware range lookup in result entry (Sub-4). CSV import extension. Covers full epic scope across all three sub-issues.
- [Admin Shell](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/admin-config/admin-shell.md): Phase 5 admin shell design brief — the SideNav + header chrome that hosts every admin page. Defines the canonical two-column layout (240px SideNav + content column), breadcrumb pattern, page-level action bar placement, and responsive collapse behavior.
- [Admin Pattern Library](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/admin-config/admin-pattern-library.md): Canonical Carbon component patterns for all OpenELIS admin pages — P-01 Admin Table, P-02 Inline Row-Expand Edit, P-03 Create Modal, P-04 Confirm-Delete Modal, P-05 Form Validation, P-06 Empty State, P-09 Breadcrumb + Header, P-13 Permission Gate. Reference for all Phase 5 admin page specs.
- [Admin Phase 5 Roadmap](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/admin-config/admin-phase5-roadmap.md): Roadmap for Phase 5 admin redesign — covers all admin pages bucketed into People & Access, Test Catalog, Configuration, QC & Quality, and Reports & Analytics. Sequencing, dependency graph, and spec completion status.
- [Test Rules Authoring Redesign — MVP](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/admin-config/test-rules-mvp-frs.md): Unified replacement for the legacy Reflex Tests Management and Calculated Value Tests Management admin pages — one route at /admin/testRules. List view mixes Rules + Calculations + Algorithms + Multi-step calcs. Inline row expansion for simple rule authoring; dedicated full-width editors for Reflex (WHEN/THEN compose + formula bar), Numeric Calc (formula bar + live preview + flowchart), and Coded Calc (decision table, e.g. TB GenoType interpretation). Algorithm-as-graph canvas is Phase 2 reference. All five previews are cross-linked — open the list view and click through. FRS: 43 numbered FRs, full AST data model, 29 acceptance criteria, ~100 i18n keys.
- [Programs Management](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/admin-config/programs-management.md): Programs admin rework (v2, consolidated) — Domain (Clinical/Environmental/Vector) field matching Test Catalog & Lab Units; moves under Admin → Test Management; inline Edit/Add (no separate page); Deactivate/Reactivate lifecycle (no hard delete) with a Show-deactivated toggle; Carbon ContentSwitcher (Visual Builder ↔ JSON) with a live "Example" preview; multi Lab-unit select; heavy on-screen guidance; API & i18n reuse guardrails. Epic: OGC-781.
- [Result & Validation Configuration v4](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/admin-config/results-validation-config-v4.md): Consolidated admin page (v4) that retires the flat Result Entry Configuration table and the binary validate-all-results toggle. Replaces them with a plain-language grouped toggles panel (13 legacy settings re-labelled across 4 groups: Result Entry, Modification/Rejection/Retest, Release & Display, Access & PII), a multi-level validation policy panel (lab-wide default + per-lab-unit overrides with 0–5 levels, trigger modes, role selects), an effective-config preview, and a plain-terms policy sentence. Route: /admin/results-validation-configuration. Drives Results Entry v4 and Validation Page v4.

## Analyzer Integration
- [Analyzer Mapping - Multi-Component Column](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/analyzer-integration/analyzer-profile-mapping.md): Delta to the Analyzer Types & Mapping table: adds a Component selector so an instrument target/channel maps to a specific result_component of a test (not only a test), resolving test-then-component by a stable code. Extends the existing analyzer-mapping-templates.jsx rather than adding a new screen. See the Multi-component mapping section of the Analyzer Types & Mapping FRS. Epic OGC-1131 / story OGC-1136.
- [Analyzer Types & Mapping](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/analyzer-integration/analyzer-profile-mapping.md): Completes the Generic ASTM/HL7/Flat-file module with reusable, forkable Analyzer Types and a lab-facing GUI to map an instrument\
- [Analyzer Types & Mapping — Gap Analysis](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/analyzer-integration/analyzer-profile-mapping-gap-analysis.md): Functional gap analysis grounding the Analyzer Types & Mapping FRS: reviews ~20 shipped Madagascar profiles and the ASTM/HL7/flat-file addenda, surfacing the inconsistent value-handling that the feature normalizes.
- [Sysmex XP Field Mapping](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/analyzer-integration/sysmex-xp-field-mapping-v0.1.md): Sysmex XP-100/XP-300 ASTM field mapping & bi-directional integration spec
- [Bruker MALDI Biotyper Integration Spec](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/analyzer-integration/bruker-maldi-biotyper-integration-spec-v1.1.md): Bruker MALDI Biotyper (MBT Compass IVD) microbial identification — ASTM LIS2-A2 socket or CSV flat file (PNG / CPHL Port Moresby).
- [Bruker MALDI Biotyper Companion Guide](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/analyzer-integration/bruker-maldi-biotyper-companion-setup-guide-v1.0.md): Bruker MALDI Biotyper (MBT Compass IVD) analyzer setup guide — instrument-side + OpenELIS configuration for organism-ID results.
- [MinION TB-Profiler Field Mapping Spec](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/analyzer-integration/minion-tbprofiler-field-mapping-v2.2.md): MinION (Oxford Nanopore) + TB-Profiler WGS-based TB drug-susceptibility — field mapping & integration spec v2.2. Rides the existing flat-file analyzer plugin into the M-14 TB Case Workbench import channel (general JSON reader + sequencing-QC block + additive M-14 molecular-result fields); not a new pipeline module. Supersedes v1.0. PNG / CPHL.
- [MinION TB-Profiler Setup Guide](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/analyzer-integration/minion-tbprofiler-setup-guide-v1.0.md): MinION + TB-Profiler analyzer setup guide — instrument/pipeline-side + OpenELIS flat-file-plugin configuration for importing TB WGS DST results into the M-14 case workbench.
- [BD EpiCenter Integration Spec](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/analyzer-integration/bd-epicenter-integration-spec-v1.0.md): BD EpiCenter microbiology / AMR data manager — ASTM LIS2-A2 (E1394-97) aggregating Phoenix/MGIT susceptibility for OpenELIS (PNG / CPHL Port Moresby).
- [BioRad CFX Opus Connection Spec](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/analyzer-integration/biorad-cfx-opus-analyzer-connection-spec.md): BioRad CFX Opus Real-Time PCR — CSV/RDML/XLSX export, LIMS integration via CFX Maestro. v1.2: export file format validated against a real CFX Maestro 5.2 XLSX workbook (Indonesia).
- [Sysmex XN-L Series Field Mapping](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/analyzer-integration/sysmex-xn-field-mapping-v0.1.md): Sysmex XN-L Series (XN-330 through XN-550) ASTM host-query bi-directional integration spec
- [DNA Technology DT-Prime Field Mapping](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/analyzer-integration/dna-technology-dtprime-field-mapping-v0.2.md): DNA Technology DT-Prime Real-Time PCR — XML file-based export, qualitative results parsing
- [Tecan Infinite F50 Connection Spec](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/analyzer-integration/tecan-infinite-f50-analyzer-connection-spec.md): Tecan Infinite F50 ELISA Reader — Magellan CSV/XML export, absorbance microplate reader
- [Thermo Multiskan FC Connection Spec](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/analyzer-integration/thermo-multiskan-fc-analyzer-connection-spec.md): Thermo Scientific Multiskan FC ELISA Reader — SkanIt CSV/TXT export, filter-based photometer
- [QuantStudio 5/7 Flex Field Mapping](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/analyzer-integration/quantstudio-field-mapping-spec-v131.md): QuantStudio 5 / 7 Flex HIV Viral Load — XLS export field mapping, 31-column Results sheet parsing
- [QuantStudio 5/7 Flex Companion Guide](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/analyzer-integration/quantstudio-companion-guide-v10.md): QuantStudio 5 / 7 Flex setup & export guide — QS D&A software export walkthrough for lab staff
- [FluoroCycler XT Integration Spec](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/analyzer-integration/fluorocycler-xt-integration-spec-v1.0.md): FluoroCycler XT Real-Time PCR — Excel flat file manual workflow for HIV Viral Load
- [FluoroCycler XT Companion Guide](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/analyzer-integration/fluorocycler-xt-companion-setup-guide-v1.0.md): FluoroCycler XT setup & export guide — Excel template workflow for lab staff
- [Tecan Infinite F50 Companion Guide](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/analyzer-integration/tecan-infinite-f50-companion-guide.md): Tecan Infinite F50 companion setup guide — Madagascar custom Excel workflow (validated)
- [Thermo Multiskan FC Companion Guide](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/analyzer-integration/thermo-multiskan-fc-companion-guide.md): Thermo Multiskan FC companion setup guide — SkanIt export configuration for OpenELIS
- [Analyzer File Upload](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/analyzer-integration/analyzer-file-upload.md): Upload and process analyzer result files
- [Analyzer Mapping Templates](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/analyzer-integration/astm-analyzer-mapping-addendum.md): Configure analyzer-to-test mapping templates
- [Flat File Analyzer Config](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/analyzer-integration/flat-file-analyzer-config.md): Configure flat file (CSV/TSV) analyzer parsers
- [HL7 Analyzer Mapping](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/analyzer-integration/hl7-analyzer-mapping-addendum.md): HL7 message field mapping for analyzers

## Blood Bank
- [Pre-Transfusion Testing](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/blood-bank/pretransfusion-testing.md): Pre-transfusion testing worklist dashboard & request case view — compatibility-filtered unit selection, crossmatch result tracking, and supervisor approval workflow (Blood Bank Spec 4)
- [Patient Blood Bank Record](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/blood-bank/patient-blood-bank-record.md): Longitudinal patient blood bank record — ABO/Rh typing history, antibody screen results, transfusion history, special requirements, and active transfusion requests (Blood Bank Spec 3)
- [Blood Bank Admin Config](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/blood-bank/blood-bank-admin-config.md): Admin configuration for blood bank component types, volume rules, storage conditions, crossmatch requirements, and expiry rules (Blood Bank Spec 1)
- [Blood Unit Inventory](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/blood-bank/blood-unit-inventory.md): Blood unit reception & inventory workbench — receive units from donors/suppliers, assign donation IDs, track storage locations, and manage unit lifecycle from receipt to transfusion (Blood Bank Spec 2)
- [Issue to Patient](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/blood-bank/issue-to-patient.md): Issue-to-patient & emergency release — issue queue for approved transfusion requests, 4-item pre-issue safety checklist, emergency crossmatch-bypass workflow with supervisor sign-off (Blood Bank Spec 5)

## Inventory & Supply
- [Reagent Forecasting Workbench](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/inventory/reagent-forecasting-workbench.md): National/regional reagent forecasting workbench — multi-facility days-of-stock table, critical/low alerts, ADC-based projections, and reorder planning for program managers
- [Inventory Item-Type Management](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/inventory/inventory-item-type-management.md): Move the hard-coded "Type of Item" list into the Data Dictionary: managed item-type admin with add/edit/deactivate, replacing hardcoded values.
- [Reagent Forecasting Facility View](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/inventory/reagent-forecasting-facility.md): Facility-level reagent stock view — per-cartridge days-of-stock monitoring, stock-count updates, and proactive reorder alerts for lab technicians at a single site

## Microbiology
- [M-00 Microbiology Module Parent](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/microbiology/m-00-micro-module-parent.md): Spine spec for the M-* bundle: glossary, RBAC matrix, data model overview, phase plan, out-of-scope, v1.1 → v2 diff map.
- [M-NFR Non-Functional Requirements](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/microbiology/m-nfr-non-functional-requirements.md): Ten cross-cutting NFRs for the Micro Module — offline, scale, audit, a11y (WCAG 2.1 AA), performance budget, retention, i18n, security, browser support, DB.
- [M-01 AMR Reference Data (Organism Master)](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/microbiology/m-01-amr-reference-data.md): Organism / Antibiotic / AST Panel / Culture Protocol masters with WHONET codes and groupings. Mockup shows Organism Master admin list.
- [M-02 Breakpoint Catalog](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/microbiology/m-02-breakpoint-catalog.md): Versioned CLSI + EUCAST breakpoint tables; AST Runs snapshot the breakpoint version at result time so publisher updates do not retroactively change interpretations.
- [M-03 Order Entry Micro Hook](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/microbiology/m-03-order-entry-micro-hook.md): Order Entry Step 1 amendment: when Program = MICROBIOLOGY, six micro-specific fields appear inline (Culture Protocol, Patient Origin, Number of Sets, Clinical History, Antibiotic Exposure, Critical Notify).
- [M-04 Isolate Modal](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/microbiology/m-04-case-workbench-core.md): Add / Edit Isolate modal — Gram stain, colony morphology, final ID, significance. Second example shows reidentification mode with versioning.
- [M-06 Expert Rules Engine](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/microbiology/m-06-expert-rules-engine.md): Configurable rules engine: MRSA inference, D-test required, ESBL screen/confirm, cascade reporting, intrinsic resistance verification. Phase 1B.
- [M-07 Pending Cultures Worklist](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/microbiology/m-07-worklists.md): Primary morning-rounds tech surface — Cases by stage with red-highlighted positives and green-highlighted ready-to-finalize.
- [M-04 Case Workbench \u2014 Interactive Prototype](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/microbiology/m-04-case-workbench-core.md): Clickable end-to-end case workup \u2014 start inoculation, add/identify isolates, set up + receive AST, log critical, release reports; stage, sidebar and next-step guidance update live; opens on the current step.
- [M-07 Worklist \u2014 Interactive Prototype](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/microbiology/m-07-worklists.md): Single shared Worklist (no per-case ownership) with a culture / AST grain toggle, needs-action cards, urgency sort, and folded-in resistance strip + recent activity; rows open the case. Analyzer results arrive automatically (no manual import).
- [Microbiology \u2014 Epic Dependency Graph](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/#/microbiology/microbiology-u2014-epic-dependency-graph): Build-order dependency graph across the 14 micro epics (OGC-782\u2013795): foundations \u2192 catalog \u2192 case hub \u2192 operational \u2192 surveillance/hub. Planning aid.
- [M-05 AST Entry \u2014 Interactive Prototype](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/microbiology/m-05-ast-entry-and-interpretation.md): Inline AST entry (no modals) \u2014 type MIC to auto-interpret; switch breakpoint standard to re-compute (EUCAST vs CLSI); inline override with revert + reading history; no-breakpoint guidance; QC-fail recovery. Analyzer results auto-ingest, no manual import.
- [M-08 Macro Library](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/microbiology/m-08-macro-library.md): Cross-cutting typing shortcuts: type .gpc, get "Gram positive cocci in clusters". 85 default macros across 8 categories. First Phase 1A+ feature.
- [M-09 WHONET Export](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/microbiology/m-09-whonet-export.md): Surveillance export with dedup parameters, validation pass, phenotype flag columns, lab profile bootstrap. To national reference lab. Phase 1B.
- [M-10 Hub Subscription](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/microbiology/m-10-hub-subscription.md): Unified admin for breakpoint + WHONET code + organism/antibiotic master updates from a central repository. OE pulls; never pushes. Phase 1B.
- [M-12 Test to Reagent Linkage](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/microbiology/m-12-test-reagent-linkage.md): General OE foundation: declare which reagent lots are required for a given test (ISO 15189 §7.3). Micro is the forcing function. Parallel pre-track to MVP-1A.
- [Microbiology — Guided Workflow Walkthrough](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/microbiology/amr-micro-narrative.md): Guided step-through that sequences the split micro prototypes into one flow — per step a description + the embedded mockup + Prev/Next, with a Bacterial/TB branch toggle. Covers admin/config setup → order & routing → bacterial or TB work-up → reporting.
- [M-14 TB Case — Interactive Prototype](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/microbiology/m-14-mycobacteriology-tb.md): The M-04 Case Workbench shell as a TB profile: smear, MGIT/LJ culture, species ID, critical-concentration DST, molecular flags, staged interim reports.
- [M-13 Antibiogram — Interactive Prototype](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/microbiology/m-13-antibiogram.md): Cumulative %S antibiogram (CLSI M39): organism × antibiotic matrix, first-isolate dedup, threshold suppression, PDF/CSV export.
- [M-04 Change Workflow / Unassigned](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/microbiology/m-04-case-workbench-core.md): M-04 §4.9 runtime escape hatch: re-classify an UNASSIGNED or mis-routed Case to the correct workflow_type (BACTERIOLOGY / MYCOBACTERIOLOGY_TB). 3 demo scenarios: unassigned, mis-routed-with-results, released-blocked.
- [M-04 Linked Cases — Shared Specimen](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/microbiology/m-04-case-workbench-core.md): Demonstrates Case keyed to sample_item_id × workflow_type: bacterial + TB on one sputum = two sibling Cases sharing one SampleItem. Worklist grouped siblings → bacterial case ↔ TB case sibling chip → order-entry 2-case preview.
- [M-09 WHONET — Painless Export](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/microbiology/m-09-whonet-export.md): Extends the existing OpenELIS WHONetReportService seam: readiness indicator, bulk auto-map by name/OCL, 3-click export with WHO-GLASS defaults, configure-once unattended delivery.
- [M-06 Expert Review — Inline Decision](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/microbiology/m-06-expert-rules-engine.md): Expert Review section → inline Review & Decide panel: accept override / order confirmation / reject + confirmation loop. No modals (Principle 3).
- [M-11 Critical Notification — Inline](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/microbiology/m-11-critical-result-acknowledgment.md): Inline Log/Acknowledge/Close flow over the existing OpenELIS notifications entity. Open → Acknowledged → Closed. Reuses alerts dashboard as criticals filter; no new Alerts Dashboard build.
- [M-13 Antibiogram](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/microbiology/m-13-antibiogram.md): Cumulative %S antibiogram (CLSI M39): organism × antibiotic matrix, first-isolate dedup, threshold suppression, data quality indicators, PDF/CSV export. Phase 2 reporting module.
- [M-14 Mycobacteriology / TB](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/microbiology/m-14-mycobacteriology-tb.md): M-04 Case Workbench extended for TB: workflow_type = MYCOBACTERIOLOGY_TB, smear microscopy, MGIT/LJ culture, species ID, WHO critical-concentration DST, molecular resistance flags (GeneXpert, Hain LPA), staged interim reports, WHONET-TB export.
- [M-15 GLASS — FHIR Surveillance](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/microbiology/m-15-glass-fhir-surveillance.md): OE pushes finalized AMR results to a consolidated FHIR server (WHO GLASS reporting path). Reuses FhirTransformService / FhirPersistanceService + EQA submission pattern. Backend/admin spec — no clinical mockup. Cross-lab aggregation stays outside OE.
- [Microbiology AMR Narrative — v2.1](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/microbiology/amr-micro-narrative.md): v2.1 narrative: folds in four post-v2.0 decisions — Case keying is SampleItem × workflow_type (not 1:1 with Sample); WHONET (M-09) extends the existing export; M-11 critical notification reuses the notifications dashboard + TestNotificationService; Expert Review (M-06) and critical log-and-acknowledge (M-11) are inline panels, not modals. Cross-module context doc for the full M-00–M-15 bundle.

## Quality & EQA
- [EQA Enrollment](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/quality/eqa-enrollment-addendum.md): EQA program enrollment, self-enrollment, and provider management
- [EQA V1 ↔ V2 Crosswalk](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/quality/eqa-v1-crosswalk.md): Reconciliation of the EQA workflow compilation against V1 FRS (eqa-requirements.md + eqa-enrollment-addendum.md) and existing mockup. Corrects ~30% of "Missing" flags in the compilation, establishes the true V2 amendment scope, and surfaces resolved decisions (separate eqa_participant_result entity, polymorphic eqa_scheme, Carbon port, tiered NCE integration, per-analyst competency).
- [EQA V2 ↔ APHL ePT Platform Crosswalk](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/quality/eqa-v2-ept-platform-crosswalk.md): Feature-by-feature comparison of OpenELIS EQA V2 MVP against APHL ePT (deforay/ept, AGPL-3.0) — the most widely deployed open-source PT platform in LMIC. Covers architectural comparison, differentiators of the integrated LIMS model, gaps (certificate issuance, multi-cycle analytics, cold-chain), and lessons for V2/V3 scoping. Informational; no binding scope changes.
- [EQA V2 Epic & Stories](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/quality/eqa-v2-epic-and-stories.md): Jira-ready Epic + Story set for EQA V2 MVP (V2.1–V2.5) and V3 Enhancements. Covers complete lifecycle: Cycle/Round entity + state machine, eqa_participant_result lifecycle, polymorphic eqa_scheme, eligible-analyst mapping, Carbon-port of V1 enrollment UI, cycle progress dashboard, auto-submit via FHIR + manual fallback, EQA→NCE tiered integration, Lab Performance dashboard, Analyst Competency view, In-House Blinding Workflow, and Provider-Side Program. V3 adds multi-cycle analytics, ISO 17043 full compliance, cold-chain receipt, and IQC correlation. Updated: panel receipt (V2.2 FR-V2.2-12) redesigned as EQA-conditional section on the standard Add Order screen — no separate modal. V3.2 extends the same section in-place with packaging checklist, tolerance validation, and disposition radio. Pending Casey approval before filing to OGC.
- [EQA V2 Design Critique](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/quality/eqa-v2-critique.md): Structural consistency scan of EQA V2 (Epic + Stories, preview, crosswalks) — five-pass /analyze across i18n, Carbon fidelity, interaction patterns, constitution alignment, and coverage gaps. 10 findings: 1 HIGH (per-analyst column integration point undocumented), 3 MEDIUM (label sheet affordance, repeat-shipment reprovisioning, provider IA role-conditional rendering), 4 LOW (terminology drifts). No V2 blockers; V3 expansion is clear to proceed. Follow-up addendum: panel receipt redesign rationale documented — receipt fields move to EQA-conditional section on standard Add Order, V3.2 cold-chain extension layers in-place on same section.
- [Westgard Dashboard](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/quality/westgard-rules.md): Laboratory Instrument Compliance Dashboard with Westgard QC rules
- [Batch Workplan Reagent QC](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/quality/batch-workplan-reagent-qc.md): Unified batch workplan with reagent lot assignment, QC verification, and automatic NCE generation on override. v1.1: aligns with merged Westgard QC engine (OGC-41, PR #3390) — QC inline entry fires QCResultCreatedEvent → existing async Westgard evaluator; QC frequency moved from Reagent to QCControlLot; new QcRun entity removed (uses existing QCResult); PER_SHIFT frequency added; NCE override links to specific QCResult + QCRuleViolation.
- [Analyzer Manual QC](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/quality/analyzer-manual-qc.md): Manual QC recording for analyzers — inline Pass/Fail entry on import page and quick-access from analyzer list
- [Environmental QC Rules](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/quality/environmental-qc-rules.md): Environmental QC Rules (S-08) — field blank, trip blank, duplicate sample (RPD), spike recovery. Per-standard QC protocol configuration, QC sample creation at order entry, inline QC results tab, and QC warning with acknowledgment modal on validation.
- [QA Menu v0.5 (IA Rehome)](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/quality/qa-menu-v0.5.md): IA rehome for all existing QA-adjacent features — lands before v1 MVP. Three pillars: Statistical QC / EQA / QMS & Improvement. Rehomes QC Dashboard, EQA, NCE Register, and Audit Trail under a top-level Quality Assurance sidenav; 301 redirects on all legacy URLs. Madagascar GRIST UAT: LO-07-02 PASS, LO-07-03 SPLIT, LO-07-04 PASS.
- [QA Menu v1 MVP (QI Dashboard)](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/quality/qa-v1-mvp-frs.md): MVP QA menu — single child node: QI Dashboard with four KPI tiles (Average TAT, Rejection Rate, Amendment Rate, NCE Pulse) computed from existing OpenELIS data. Includes three new REST wrappers, per-tile detail placeholders with filterable tables, permission registry additions (qa.view.overview, qa.view.qi, qa.manage.qi), and a QA Officer default role. Builds on top of the v0.5 IA container. ~45–55h with Claude.
- [QA Menu v2 (E-Sig + Accreditation IA)](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/#/quality/qa-menu-v2-e-sig-accreditation-ia): v2 QA menu — adds the Electronic Signature Log, IA shell for Lab Accreditation Status (read-only, community-led), and full rehome stubs for all four pillars. Builds on v1 QI Dashboard. Does not ship net-new functional QI pages; those land in v3+. E-Sig Log replaces the four-table UNION ALL originally specced with a unified electronic_signature table.
- [QA Menu — End State](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/#/quality/qa-menu-end-state): End-state vision for the full QA menu — all four pillars live (Statistical QC / EQA / QI / QMS & Improvement), full QI Dashboard with heatmap + Pareto charts on all QI pages, QI Configuration admin page, NCE Register modernization with CAPA + effectiveness review, EQA V2, read-only Accreditation Status (aligned to test-accreditation-frs.md), and the daily-focused QA Overview redesign. Reference target for the full release plan.
- [QA Westgard Phase 2](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/quality/qa-westgard-phase2-frs.md): Four bounded improvements to the existing Westgard/QC Dashboard module — organized in three priority tiers. Tier 1 (must-do, ~10–14h): active-violations alert banner + auto-create NCE on critical violations. Tier 2 (should-do, ~8–12h): statistical-method completion + sigma metrics display. Tier 3 (community candidate, ~10–15h): QC reporting/trend export (CSV + PDF). All tiers build on infrastructure already in OpenELIS.
- [QA Release Budget Calculator](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/quality/qa-release-plan.md): Interactive single-page budget calculator for the full QA release plan. Toggle individual items and use presets (Floor / Recommended / Inspector-ready / Stretch / Complete) to see total hours. Each item carries a one-line description, phase label, and hour range. Computed from the effort estimates in qa-release-plan.md and effort-estimate-with-claude.md.

## Reports
- [S06c — Environmental LHU](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/reports/S06c-environmental-lhu-frs-v1.0.md): S-06c — Environmental Laporan Hasil Uji (LHU) sibling spec to S06. Result table columns No. | Parameter | Hasil Uji | Baku Mutu | Satuan | Ket. (Metode dropped, in compact footnote). Water, food, ambient air, surface swabs, and physical conditions matrices. KAN per-parameter asterisk; multi-matrix bundling. Ships canonical Indonesian preview + bilingual annotated sibling.
- [S06d — Vector LHU](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/reports/S06d-vector-lhu-frs-v1.0.md): S-06d — Vector surveillance Laporan Hasil Uji (LHU) sibling spec to S06. Three flexible result-table modes: A (Species ID via PCR), B (Surveillance Indices — MIR, infection rate, density), C (Larval Population Indices — House/Container/Breteau Index, Angka Bebas Jentik). Multi-LHU number bundling. Ships canonical Indonesian preview + bilingual annotated sibling.
- [Report Print Queue](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/reports/report-print-queue.md): Report-type-agnostic print queue (v1.3): auto-surfaces validated-but-unprinted reports; completeness indicators, print recording via existing report tracking. r3 filter bar redesign — Facility / Ward / Requestor are FilterableMultiSelect with server-side typeahead, Lab No is a first-class toolbar lookup, Search by Patient opens inline, and targeted searches are exclusive (suspend browse filters).
- [Patient Report Redesign](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/reports/patient-report-redesign.md): Full redesign of the patient result report — Carbon-aligned layout, accreditation logo, digital signature block, reference range display, result interpretation flagging. Ships two JRXML templates: patient_letter.jrxml (US Letter) and patient_a4.jrxml (A4), selected via Admin → General Configuration → Printed Reports Configuration. Companion patient_letter.jrxml implementation file co-located in designs/reports/. Covers the admin config surface, rendered output spec, and Jasper coordinate-level implementation notes.
- [Positivity Rate Report](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/reports/positivity-rate.md): Positivity rate report and dashboard widget — per-test result-code-based positivity definitions, date-range filtering, DataTable with CSV export, and reusable tile for the home dashboard
- [Disease Surveillance Dashboard](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/reports/disease-surveillance-dashboard.md): Public-health surveillance dashboard — weekly TB/HIV positivity trends, volume-by-site breakdowns, and FHIR-sourced aggregate indicators for program managers
- [Custom Data Export](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/reports/custom-data-export.md): 3-step report builder wizard with field selection, filter configuration, and scheduling — plus async My Report Queue and Saved Export Configurations panel
- [TAT Report](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/reports/tat-report.md): Turn Around Time Report — summary stats, detail list, trends, and CSV export for lab performance analysis (OGC-307)

## Results & Validation
- [Results Entry v4](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/results-validation/results-entry-v4.md): ⚠️ SUPERSEDED by the Multi-Component (integrated) FRS (results-entry-multicomponent.md). Results Entry consolidated redesign (v4) — per-row edit-state lock, Method + Analyzer split columns, inline NCE (real InlineNceForm field set), inline remaining-volume / disposal trigger, dual-axis notes, contrast-ratio critical flags, bulk-release action, cross-domain (Clinical/Environmental/Vector via Lab Unit). Supersedes v3 Results Page. Companion: Validation Page v4 and Result & Validation Configuration v4 (admin).
- [Validation Page v4](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/results-validation/validation-page-v4.md): ⚠️ SUPERSEDED by the Multi-Component (integrated) FRS (validation-multicomponent.md). Validation Page consolidated redesign (v4) — NCE / QC-fail / modification / critical-ack triage chips in the list view, smart bulk-release (excludes unreviewed criticals), Method + Analyzer split columns, inline rejection with NCE record, per-row review state, e-signature on release. Cross-domain (Clinical/Environmental/Vector). Companion: Results Entry v4 and Result & Validation Configuration v4.
- [Results Entry — Multi-Component (integrated)](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/results-validation/results-entry-multicomponent.md): New full Results Entry FRS that carries forward all v4 scope and natively integrates multi-component result entry — a test defining more than one result_component shows one result field per component, reusing the existing result-cell renderer; single-component tests are unchanged. First use case: molecular target gene + Ct (Xpert MTB/RIF, SARS-CoV-2). Supersedes the Results Entry v4 FRS. Companion: Validation Page — Multi-Component (integrated) and the v1 additive module.
- [Validation Page — Multi-Component (integrated)](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/results-validation/validation-multicomponent.md): New full Validation Page FRS that carries forward all v4 scope and adds read-only multi-component display — for a test with more than one result_component the review panel shows every component (value, label, unit, range, flag) in order so the validator reviews the whole result before releasing. Supersedes the Validation Page v4 FRS. Companion: Results Entry — Multi-Component (integrated).
- [Analyzer Ingestion — Multi-Component Results](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/results-validation/analyzer-multicomponent-ingestion.md): FRS for analyzer ingestion of multi-component results — extends the analyzer import + mapping so a reported target/channel resolves to a (test, component) pair, not only a test. A multiplex molecular run (GeneXpert per-probe values, BioRad CFX Opus per-fluor Cq rows) populates a multi-component test\
- [Result & Validation v4 — Dependency Map](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/#/results-validation/result-validation-v4-dependency-map): Interactive Mermaid dependency map for the v4 Results & Validation redesign — shows build order across Configuration (C1–C3), Results Entry (RE1–RE7), and Validation (V1–V4) slices. Green nodes are ready to build; red nodes are gated on unbuilt dependencies. Reference for the implementing pipeline.
- [Results Entry v4 — Design Decisions](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/results-validation/results-entry-v4-decisions.md): Cross-surface design decisions log (D1–D22) for the v4 Results & Validation redesign. Covers edit-state machine (D1), inline NCE (D2), Method/Analyzer split (D3–D5), reagent capture (D6), dual-axis notes (D7), critical flags (D8–D9), bulk-release (D10), rejection (D11–D12), multi-level validation policy (D13–D15), config consolidation (D16–D18), and cross-domain behavior (D19–D22). Referenced by the FRSs — filename kept stable so cross-links hold.
- [Results Validation v4 — Story Breakdown](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/results-validation/results-validation-v4-breakdown.md): PR-sized story breakdown for the v4 Results & Validation redesign. 14 slices across Configuration (C1–C3), Results Entry (RE1–RE7), and Validation (V1–V4), dependency-ordered. Includes Jira key map (OGC-1016–1030), story points, covered FRS sections, and cross-cutting concerns per slice. Build order: Config first, then green-node RE/V slices, gated (red) slices last.
- [Validation Page (Analyzer)](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/analyzer-integration/validation-page.md): Analyzer result validation workflow
- [Validation Page v2 (Full Redesign)](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/validation-page/validation-page-requirements-v2.md): Full v2 redesign — multi-level validation pipeline, admin config, role-based levels, auto-validation
- [Validation Page v2.1 (Stage 1)](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/validation-page/validation-page-requirements-v2.1-stage1.md): Stage 1 scoped — multi-signature pipeline with minimal UI changes to existing validation page
- [Validation Page v3 (Demographics)](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/validation-page/validation-patient-demographics-frs-v1.md): v3 adds patient sex and age (D-M-Y) columns for demographic-aware reference range verification
- [Patient Demographics Mockup](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/validation-page/validation-patient-demographics-frs-v1.md): Patient demographics display — sex tag, age calculation, patient info header with Carbon components
- [Patient Demographics FRS](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/validation-page/validation-patient-demographics-frs-v1.md): Patient Sex & Age Display on Validation Screen FRS v1.0 — D-M-Y age format, sex normalization
- [HIL Specimen Quality](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/results-validation/hil-specimen-quality.md): End-to-end capture, surfacing, and audit of specimen interference — Hemolysis, Icterus, Lipemia. Covers analyzer ingestion → validator UI → patient report. New admin page for severity-action thresholds. Extends Generic ASTM 1.2 profile with a specimen_quality_field_mapping slot. Lights up the dormant HIL chip already designed in the patient report redesign.
- [Multi-Component Result Entry v1](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/results-validation/results-entry-multicomponent-v1.md): V1 additive multi-value capture on the existing Results Entry & Validation page (SearchResultForm.jsx). A test that defines more than one result_component renders one result-entry field PER component, each produced by the same result-cell renderer the primary result uses today (chosen by the component result_type). Single-component tests are unchanged. First use case: molecular target gene + Ct (Xpert MTB/RIF, SARS-CoV-2). Consumes the OGC-949 M1 test_result_component model; replaces the PR #3831 scalar-column approach (no new analysis/test columns, no data migration). Self-contained module intended for a future fold-in to the OGC-811/817 inline results redesign.
- [Reagent Usage on Result Entry v1](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/results-validation/results-page-reagent-usage-v1.md): Interim v1 — captures reagent lot usage at the point of result entry. Adds a Method & Reagents tab to the results entry page with lot selection, expiry display, and usage logging. Designed as a drop-in complement to the existing results page without requiring a full redesign.
- [Reagent Usage on Result Entry v2.1](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/results-validation/results-page-reagent-usage-v1.md): v2.1 iteration of the Method & Reagents tab — drop-in replacement for the existing ReagentLotSelection block. Refines lot picker UX, adds inline expiry warnings, and improves the usage audit trail display. No FRS change from v1; mockup-only update.
- [Results Entry — Expanded Uncertainty (U) Capture](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/results-validation/results-entry-expanded-uncertainty.md): Results Entry screen enhancement (OGC-775, S-15a MVP) — adds an optional U (k=2) numeric column to the results table for ISO 17025 §7.8.3.1(c) expanded measurement uncertainty capture. Backward-compatible: labs without uncertainty leave the cell blank. The LHU v2.0 (OGC-552) conditional U column reads this value when populated. MVP scope only — no tooltips, admin toggle, or method-level prefill; those land in S-15a v2 if needed.

## Sample Collection
- [SOP Deadline Calculation](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/sample-collection/sop-deadline-calculation.md): S-03d v2.0 Addendum to S-03 (ENV/Vector only) — SOP holding-time auto-calculation and worklist deadline flagging. v2.0 splits the generic Required-By field to the GENERIC-OE spec; this spec covers only ENV/Vector holding-time: minimum sop_max_holding_hours across tests, live suggestion with most-restrictive-test annotation, manual override. Worklist Deadline column: green/amber/red tags, Approaching/Overdue filter chips.
- [Informed Consent Capture](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/sample-collection/informed-consent.md): Informed consent capture section for sample order entry (OGC-557) — collapsible accordion with consent checkbox and optional form reference number, auditable agent/timestamp record for ISO 15189 compliance. Reusable ConsentAccordionSection component for Add Order and Edit Order workflows.
- [Required By Field](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/sample-collection/required-by-field.md): GENERIC cross-cutting OE feature — Required-By date+time field on Order Entry Step 1 for all order types (clinical, env, vector, EQA). Unifies eqa_deadline into order.required_by. Reuses EQA DatePicker pattern. Split from S-03d v1.0; this generic piece belongs in the core OE backlog, not the Env/Vector epic.
- [Inter-Lab Transfer](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/sample-collection/inter-lab-transfer.md): S-14 — Inter-lab transfer and subcontract, addendum to the existing OE Refer Out / Referral module. Supersedes S-03c (env/vector subcontract). Merges general inter-lab transfer and env/vector subcontract into one addendum covering all order types: transfer metadata, chain-of-custody tracking, five-state status workflow, overdue highlighting.
- [Reference Lab Results](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/sample-collection/reference-lab-results.md): New SideNav item under Sample Shipment. Outstanding / Returned-needs-action / History views for tracking the data lifecycle of referrals after physical shipment. Migrates ReferralStatus enum to FHIR Task states; adds manual-entry path for non-OpenELIS reference labs; Accept/Reject with terminal close + re-collection notification; Box.Reconciled gate. Supersedes OGC-624 state-model scope.
- [Pre-Analytical Eligibility Gate](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/sample-collection/pre-analytical-eligibility-gate.md): S-09 v3.0 — Pre-Analytical Eligibility Gate & Resampling, simplification rewrite of v2.0. Replaces the auto-evaluating per-SampleType criteria engine with a generic, manually-completed sample acceptance checklist at reception Step 3, plus a Resample action that rejects a sample and spawns a linked pre-populated draft order with requester notification. Configuration is a lightweight master list, fully decoupled from the Test Catalog editor (which removed the SampleType admin tab v2.0 depended on). No new status enum, no new permission keys. See analysis + story-breakdown docs.
- [Sample Collection Redesign v2.1 — Referral Addendum](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/sample-collection/sample-collection-referral-addendum.md): v2.1 Addendum to Sample Collection Redesign — restores Refer Out workflow into Step 3 (Label & Store). Inline per-test referral assignment, bulk "Refer all" modal, REFERRED_OUT order status, QA bypass for fully-referred orders, partial referral handling, and Order Dashboard filters. Reuses existing Refer Out module mechanics and X-01 notification trigger.

## System
- [Audit Trail](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/system/audit-trail.md): System audit trail viewer
- [In-App Help System](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/system/help-menu.md): Contextual in-app help viewer for OpenELIS Global — a slide-over panel triggered from a persistent Help button in the app shell. Delivers page-aware help articles (Markdown rendered to HTML), full-text search across all articles, related-articles suggestions, feedback thumbs (helpful / not helpful), and a "request help" escape hatch to the community forum. Content managed as static Markdown files in the repo. FRS v1.0 with full data model, i18n keys, acceptance criteria, and requirements checklist.
- [Analyzer Results Import (v2 redesign)](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/system/analyzer-import-redesign-v2.md): OGC-288 redesign of the Analyzer Results Import review page. QC-first review with per-analysis accept/reject and the QC-fail action set (Retest / Report NCE / Reject / Accept despite QC failure), select-all + normal selection, a run-settings sidebar, and the G1-G13 bench-experience refinements. Multi-component-aware: per-target Ct/Cq values grouped by analysis, with unmapped targets surfaced as visible exceptions. Access moved to the results permission. Supersedes the wireframe-era Analyzer Import entry, carrying its QC-first / run-settings / sidebar mechanics forward in FRS form.
- [Analyzer Import](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/system/analyzer-import.md): [Superseded by Analyzer Results Import (v2 redesign), OGC-288] Bulk analyzer configuration import (wireframe-era analyzer results import redesign).
- [FHIR Outbound Push](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/system/fhir-outbound-push.md): Event-driven FHIR R4 outbound push to a central national hub — DiagnosticReport bundle assembly on final validation, retry queue, delivery log, and admin configuration for endpoint, auth (API key, OAuth 2.0, Basic, Private Key JWT), and per-resource toggles
- [FHIR Publication Settings](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/#/system/fhir-publication-settings): Admin configuration page for FHIR R4 outbound publication — endpoint URL, per-resource toggles (DiagnosticReport, Observation, ServiceRequest, Device, Organization), authentication modes (API key, OAuth 2.0, Basic auth, Private Key JWT with public key upload), DHIS2 push URL, and live connection test. Companion admin UI for the FHIR Outbound Push pipeline (OGC-446).
- [Storage Disposition FHIR](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/system/storage-disposition-fhir.md): S-05b Addendum to S-05 (Compliance Evaluation Engine) — FHIR Specimen resource update triggered when ENV/Vector sample final disposition is recorded (Disposed or Biorepository). Animated FHIR push pipeline simulation: OpenELIS Storage → SPECIMEN_DISPOSITION_FINAL event → Async Queue → HAPI FHIR R4 → OHS ETL → Future Dashboard. Interactive Specimen JSON payload explorer with collapsible sections, disposition-type toggle, and specimen-final-disposition extension annotations. Best-effort non-blocking push with 3× retry, delivery logging, and sampleDomain gating for ENV/Vector orders only.
- [Lab Management Dashboard](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/system/lab-management-dashboard.md): Management Overview dashboard (v1, 2026-06 redesign) — what-needs-attention focus: pending workload by section, TAT health, analyzer/QC/reagent alerts, throughput. Part of the Dashboards & Home redesign FRS (Home + Management Dashboard, one epic).
- [Electronic Signature](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/system/electronic-signature.md): Electronic signature capture and audit trail for 21 CFR Part 11 compliance — authenticated sign-off for results validation, report release, and critical value acknowledgment
- [Catalyst Lab Data Assistant](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/#/system/catalyst-lab-data-assistant): AI-powered lab data assistant with natural language querying, wizard-based report building, and contextual help

## Vector Surveillance
- [Compliance Standards Administration](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/admin-config/compliance-standards-admin.md): Admin configuration for compliance standards (ISO 15189, WHO, CLSI) — link standards to test catalog entries, QC rules, and sampling protocols. Part of the Vector/Environmental LIMS epic.
- [Sample Type Domain Classification](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/admin-config/sample-type-domain-classification.md): Sample Type Domain Classification (S-04) — adds sampleDomain enum (CLINICAL/ENVIRONMENTAL/BOTH) to Sample Type entity, bulk assignment utility, and workflow toggle filtering. Addendum to OGC-296.
- [Vector Specimen Types & Taxonomy](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/vector-surveillance/vector-reference-data.md): Vector reference data (V-01) — species taxonomy (genus + species + subspecies), trap types, and vector sample types with pooling strategy. Establishes the foundation for vector surveillance by extending SampleType.sampleDomain with VECTOR, adding VectorSpecimenProfile for pooling configuration, and seeding ~40 species and 15 trap types used in Indonesia.
- [Vector Collection Workflow](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/vector-surveillance/vector-collection-workflow.md): V-02 Vector Collection Workflow — extends the 4-step Sample Collection Redesign with a Vector domain toggle (Clinical | Environmental / Other | Vector). Adds CollectionLot entity with trap type, GPS coordinates (pre-filled from sampling site), pool flag, organism count, weather conditions, receipt confirmation, and S-09 eligibility gate integration at Step 4.
- [Vector Testing & Identification](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/vector-surveillance/vector-testing-identification.md): V-03 Vector Testing & Identification (v1.11) — species identification workbench with inline per-specimen form, bulk-apply for homogeneous lots, physiological state capture (UNFED/BLOOD_FED/HALF_GRAVID/GRAVID per Detinova classification), molecular detail (target gene, assay, GenBank accession), pool deconvolution (positive pool → LABNO.X-Y aliquots → re-test). Blood-meal analysis, Plasmodium drug-resistance genotyping, and vector insecticide-resistance now in V-03 scope via reflex rules. Auto-suggests Blood-Meal Panel when physiologicalState = BLOOD_FED. Seed Panels: Dengue, Malaria, Chikungunya, Blood-Meal ID, Plasmodium Drug Resistance, Vector Insecticide Resistance. Reflex rules VR-01–VR-06.
- [Vector Surveillance Reporting](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/vector-surveillance/vector-surveillance-reporting.md): V-04 Vector Surveillance Reporting — Apache Superset dashboard embedded via guest token JWT into the Reports → Vector Surveillance page, backed by an OHS SQL-on-FHIR ETL pipeline that flattens HAPI FHIR resources into Postgres analytics views feeding 4–7 charts (trap catch trend, species distribution, MIR heatmap, pathogen positivity). NEW in v1.5 — Manual Entry Helper tab at /reports/vector-surveillance/manual-entry that accelerates manual submission to the Kemenkes Subdit Vektor SILANTOR portal: large-font numeric Tiles per metric with Copy IconButton, Aedes/Anopheles sub-tabs, Sporozoite-rate auto-gating below 95% positive resolution, and a Mark-Week-Submitted modal that writes an audit row. Admin field-map page at /admin/vector/manual-entry-fields lets deployments re-order and relabel metrics without code changes; metric list, cadence, and portal field tags are marked @TBD-Ida pending APHL Indonesia confirmation.
- [Compliance Evaluation Engine](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/results-validation/compliance-evaluation-engine.md): S-05 v2.0 — Regulation-scoped reference ranges: numeric threshold evaluation per compliance standard × result component. 2026-04-28 amendment: evaluates per regulation (from M:N order_compliance_standard join) and per component (for multi-component tests). Existing fallback chain preserved. Splits descriptive/categorical vocabulary to S-05a.
- [Reusable Categorical Vocabulary](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/results-validation/reusable-categorical-vocabulary.md): S-05a — Reusable categorical result vocabulary, split from S-05 v1.0. Admin surface for defining reusable descriptive tag sets (e.g. specimen quality flags, vector physiological state, clinical morphology) that can be attached to any test result type. Domain-neutral; extends beyond env/compliance use cases.
- [Environmental LHU](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/vector-surveillance/environmental-lhu.md): Environmental Laporan Hasil Uji v2.0 — printable test result report for environmental samples (air, water, soil, sediment, food). v2.0 adds ISO/IEC 17025:2017 §7.8 report-face blocks (results-apply-only disclaimer, decision rule, end-of-report marker, reproduction restriction), conditional measurement uncertainty (U) column, subcontract disclosure, sampling responsibility, method validation status annotations, and amendment workflow. Inherits S-06 letterhead, e-signature, and print config. Multi-matrix result table with compliance icons, KAN accreditation handling, and Baku Mutu regulatory reference. Real data from PT. Unggulrejo Wasono & RS Permata Depok.
- [Vector LHU](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/vector-surveillance/vector-lhu.md): Vector Laporan Hasil Uji v2.0 — printable surveillance report for BBLKM/Labkesmas. Four result-table modes: Species ID (PCR + arbovirus serotype/genotype), Surveillance Indices (MIR + MLE with 95% CIs per WHO 2021), Larval Population (HI/CI/BI + ABJ vs Kemenkes 95% target), and NEW Mode D Pupae Per Person Index (PPI) per WHO 2003 / Focks et al. 2000. Adds ISO 17025 §7.8 report-face blocks. Trap type, lure, deployment period, hierarchical geographic resolution (province → kelurahan → RT/RW). Deployment-configurable risk thresholds (PAHO 2017 + Permenkes 50/2017). Real data from BBLKM Jakarta Aedes aegypti.
- [Collection Lot — Trap Details](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/vector-surveillance/collection-lot-trap-details.md): V-02 Vector Collection Workflow form enhancement (OGC-777, V-05a STRETCH) — adds a "Trap Configuration" section to the existing CollectionLot edit form with four new optional fields: lure, deployment_start, deployment_end, storage_temperature_c. WHO entomological surveillance reproducibility requirements. Backward-compatible: existing CollectionLots remain valid with NULL values. LHU Mode A footnote auto-degrades when fields are null. STRETCH: partner labs do not yet capture this granularity.
- [Laporan Hasil — Compliance Report](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/reports/S06-laporan-hasil-compliance-report-frs-v1.0.md): Laporan Hasil (S-06) — formal Sertifikat Hasil Uji (Test Results Certificate) PDF generation for validated environmental orders. Dual e-signature, batch ZIP download, shared Report Print Configuration admin page. Amended 2026-06-15 with §7a Domain Variants cross-reference to S06c (Environmental LHU) + S06d (Vector LHU) siblings.
- [LH Delivery — Sent Messages Tab](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/reports/lh-delivery-sent-messages.md): S-06b Addendum — LH Delivery Notification: Sent Messages global main-menu tab. Per-channel delivery status (Email ✓/✗, WhatsApp ✓/✗) for Laporan Hasil, clinical, and future notifications. Extends OGC-437 (TextIt SMS) + OGC-439 (Email/SMTP) triggers with LH_COMPLETED event. Resend flow, delivery log modal, and secure customer download page with 30-day token.
- [Environmental Dashboard & Trend Analysis](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/reports/environmental-dashboard.md): Environmental Dashboard (S-07) — site-level compliance rate trends, per-parameter drill-down, exceedance summary table, site comparison bar chart, CSV export. Monthly aggregation with 12-month default view.
- [ENV Dashboard — Chart & PDF Export](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/reports/environmental-dashboard-chart-export.md): S-07b Addendum — Chart PNG & Dashboard PDF Export. Per-chart hover download button (client-side SVG→PNG, 1200×800px @144dpi). Full-dashboard PDF export: config modal, server-side generation, cover page, one chart per page, exceedance table, footer. ROLE_ENV_EXPORT permission gates both actions. Annotated mockup shows new S-07b additions in context of the existing S-07 dashboard (gold dashed border = new, dimmed = existing).
- [Sample Collection Redesign](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/sample-collection/sample-collection-redesign.md): Decoupled 4-step sample lifecycle: Enter Order → Collect Sample → Label & Store → QA Review
- [Sampling Site Registry](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/sample-collection/sampling-site-registry.md): Environmental LIMS sampling site registry — manage sampling locations, GPS coordinates, site types, and compliance linkage to S-01 standards with hierarchical site grouping (S-02)
- [Environmental Order Entry](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/sample-collection/environmental-order-entry.md): S-03 v2.0 — 3-step wizard (Branch & Setup / Label & Store / QA-QC + Intake) at Reception for domain-assigned labs. Regulation-driven vs ad-hoc branch selector, sample manifest quantity table + CSV upload, per-sample NCE, QC quick-add. 2026-04-28 amendment: multi-regulation M:N — Compliance Standard is now a MultiSelect; suggested tests union across selected standards; order_compliance_standard join table replaces single complianceStandardId column.
- [ENV Order — Sampling Uncertainty Field](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/sample-collection/sampling-uncertainty.md): S-03b Addendum — Sampling Uncertainty field added to the Collection Conditions section (S-03 §5.3). ISO 17025 §7.6 field/sampling uncertainty: NumberInput value + unit type Select (%, mg/L, μg/L, CFU/100mL, Other). Mandatory by default, configurable optional per program. Carries forward to Step 2 via ENV-3-002. QA completeness check extended. Laporan Hasil reporting payload extended.
- [Clinical Order Entry (v2)](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/sample-collection/order-entry-frs-v3-three-workflows.md): v2 clinical order-entry wizard (Enter Order \u2192 Collect \u2192 Label & Store \u2192 QA Review) realigned to the three-workflow spec. Adds the self-describing "Assign to" sample\u2194test menu at Collect, Ward/Unit/Department facility sub-unit, requester with Phone/Fax/Email + admin-gated add-new + edit-lock on found records, test search by name or code, blank-by-default quantity, de-gated print/storage, and the Sample Acceptance Checklist (S-09 / OGC-580) on QA Review.
- [Environmental Order Entry (v2)](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/sample-collection/order-entry-frs-v3-three-workflows.md): v2 environmental order-entry. Requester = Requesting Organization + Requestor contact, both searched & stored like the clinical provider, with full Phone/Fax/Email, admin-gated add-new, and edit-lock on records pulled from search. Collection method optional; CSV bulk intake retained (Env/Vector only).
- [Vector Collection Workflow (v2)](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/sample-collection/order-entry-frs-v3-three-workflows.md): v2 vector collection workflow. Requester relabeled to the shared Requesting Organization + Requestor element (identical to Environmental), with full Phone/Fax/Email, admin-gated add-new, and edit-lock on found records.
- [Order Entry \u2014 Developer Reference](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/sample-collection/order-entry-developer-reference.md): Single source of truth for the order-entry realignment (epic OGC-1066): north-star model, per-stage behavior, current\u2192required defect table with live evidence, anti-drift guardrails, and the story map (OGC-1067\u20131073). Anchor doc for Reagan + coding agents.
- [Referral-Out Notification](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/notifications/referral-out-notification.md): X-01 Addendum — Configurable REFERRAL_OUT notification trigger added to existing Refer Out module. Extends OGC-437/OGC-439 dispatch pipeline with one new event type, Combined Triggers Page row (default OFF), Combined Templates Page editor with merge fields, and Sent Messages tab "Referral Out" type. Three scenes: triggers config, template editor with live preview, sent messages table.
- [Subcontract Management](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/notifications/subcontract-management.md): S-03c Addendum to S-03 + V-02 — Structured subcontract tracking for ENV/Vector Refer Out referrals. Subcontract Metadata panel (handoff datetime, expected return, agreement ref, chain-of-custody contact). Five-state status workflow (DISPATCHED → RECEIVED → RESULTS_RETURNED → CLOSED). Subcontract Register page with overdue highlighting, status filters, and Advance Status modal. Audit log per transition. ISO 17025 §6.6 / §7.7 compliance. Superseded by S-14 Inter-Lab Transfer (generic to all order types).
- [Environmental & Vector Testing Roadmap](https://digi-uw.github.io/openelis-work/designs/other/environmental-vector-roadmap.md): Architecture roadmap for the Environmental & Vector Testing Module (OGC-527 epic). Covers 3-layer build order: S-01–S-02 foundational infrastructure, S-03–S-04 integration, S-05–S-08 analytics/reporting, V-01–V-04 vector surveillance. Dependency graph, recommended implementation phases, and current spec completion status.
